summary: Frontend-only testing of network monitoring tool enhancements. All new features (device search, data type selectors, OID list columns) working correctly.
passed_tests: Device search input present with data-testid='device-search-input'
Search by device name filters correctly ('Core' finds Core-Router-01 and Switch-Core-01)
Search by IP address filters correctly ('192.168' filters devices)
Search results count displays correctly (e.g., 'Found 2 devices matching Core')
Search clear (X) button clears the search field
Search within category works (searching 'Edge' in Routers category finds Edge-Router-02)
Add Device dialog shows data type selector with 7 options
Add Template dialog shows same 7 data type options
Data type options include: Gauge, Counter, Mbps, Kbps, Bytes, Percentage, Text
OID list in Device dialog shows 6 columns: OID, NAME, TYPE, UNIT, WARNING, CRITICAL
OID list in Template dialog shows 6 columns including Type
Device detail page shows data type badge for each OID (e.g., 'Gauge')
Device detail page shows formatted values with correct units (%, ms, etc.)
Category filtering works correctly (Routers, Switches, etc.)
Navigation between Dashboard, Devices, Alerts, Templates working
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features for device search and SNMP OID data types are working correctly. The formatValue function properly converts values based on data type (Mbps divides by 1M, percentage adds %, bytes auto-scales). Search functionality filters by both name and IP within categories.

mocked_api.note: SNMP polling and ping monitoring is MOCKED - backend uses random values instead of actual network polling
